# Wildflower Films
> Cape Town Wedding Filmmakers & Videographers based in Cape Town, South Africa.

Wildflower Films creates timeless, story-driven wedding films across Cape Town, Stellenbosch, Franschhoek, Paarl, Hermanus, and destination venues across South Africa.

## Packages
- Essential (R5,000): 6 hours coverage, edited highlights video, drone footage, digital delivery.
- Premium (R6,500): 8 hours coverage, full wedding film, highlight reel, drone footage, digital delivery.
- Cinematic (R8,000): Full day coverage, full wedding film, highlight reel, drone footage, digital delivery.

## Official Website
- https://wildflowerfilms.co.za/
